showcase.description: A synthetic lumbar MRI request satisfying the verified CPB 0236 radiculopathy branch: radicular back pain, an objective root-distribution finding, and six-plus weeks of unsuccessful conservative therapy.
showcase.title: Lumbar MRI ready for administrative review
showcase.why_interesting: Shows an official policy clause mapped to four deterministic requirements and their evidence spans.

showcase.description: The note mentions OSA and a past sleep study, but it leaves out the date and AHI details required to determine readiness.
showcase.title: CPAP request refused for missing documentation
showcase.why_interesting: Shows refusal-first behavior when required evidence is missing instead of inferred.

showcase.description: This note satisfies the radiculopathy, objective-finding, and non-response elements, but conservative therapy remains below the official six-week threshold.
showcase.title: Documented, but not yet ready to submit
showcase.why_interesting: Shows a directly source-backed threshold failure rather than a missing-documentation refusal.

showcase.description: A CPAP request that includes OSA documentation, a slash-formatted sleep study date, and an RDI value.
showcase.title: CPAP ready case with alternative date formatting
showcase.why_interesting: Shows cross-domain breadth and a small extraction robustness edge case.

showcase.description: A separate synthetic cervical MRI pathway demonstrating reusable deterministic architecture without inheriting lumbar's verified-policy trust.
showcase.title: Cervical MRI ready case using the new supported pathway
showcase.why_interesting: Shows that the shared service and rule registry can support new deterministic procedures without changing the engine shape.

showcase.description: A non-spine advanced imaging request that stays narrow: symptom duration, therapy duration, prior xray context, and explicit mechanical symptom review.
showcase.title: Knee MRI ready case with explicit mechanical symptoms
showcase.why_interesting: Shows deeper deterministic product coverage without changing the engine shape or widening into clinical scoring.
